model_interpretation.claim: The valid direct-global (32,8) candidate averaged 3.4738 µs versus the 3.5815 µs baseline, while (32,4) and (64,2) were slower. This experiment keeps one warp on adjacent X outputs at fixed Y/Z but uses a (32,16) block, reducing the grid from 1024 to 512 CTAs relative to (32,8). It tests whether fewer, larger CTAs help this small workload or instead increase resource pressure; no speedup is assumed.
